english.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese noun for rising prices and declining purchasing power.

examples.english: The inflation has gotten so bad that even the cha chaan teng we usually eat at has raised its prices.
examples.traditional: 最近通脹太勁，連平時食開嘅茶餐廳都加價。
